parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the event bus.

parameters.name: EventBusName
parameters.description: The name of the event bus.

parameters.name: FilterPattern
parameters.description:
The event pattern, in JSON format. Valid values: stringEqual and stringExpression. You can specify up to five expressions in the map data structure in each field.

You can specify up to five expressions in the map data structure in each field.

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description: The name of the event rule.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The status of the event rule. Valid values: ENABLE: enables the event rule. It is the default status of the event rule. DISABLE: disables the event rule.
